pr_title: fix(esm): show codeframe when errors get reported
pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/15244

Abstract: stack-utils return file locations as `file://` in ESM mode. We handled this case already correctly inside `playwright-core`, and this patch applies the same fix inside `playwright-test`.

drive-by: replace `new URL(frame.file).pathname` with `url.fileURLToPath`

issue_context.title: Codeframe is not shown when ESM mode is used
issue_context.body: fixme with one of these tests: https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/15206/files

review_comments: Interesting—I wonder if this ever worked on Windows. This seems like it would have always been giving the wrong path sep. Do we use this hack elsewhere? (Granted it looks like[ `url.fileURLToPath` was only fixed in 2019](https://github.com/nodejs/node/commit/7237eaa3353aacf284289c8b59b0a5e0fa5744bb) to do the correct thing on windows.)
lets see what the bots say, on my mac it passed. it was fixed in 2019, so its fine, since we only support Node.js 14 officially which was released in 2020.
😎 Nice! I know I added this test specifically for the ESM case, but do we have one testing the non-ESM case, too?
